metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Power to take samples.
article.content: The Commissioner or an officer authorised by him may take samples of goods from the possession of any taxable person, where he considers it necessary, and provide a receipt for any samples so taken.

Section 154 · Chapter XXI · page 118 of the Act
